Sheet Pan Gnocchi with Sausage

A synthetic one-pan dinner.
Servings 4 people

Ingredients

For the gnocchi

  • 1 lb shelf-stable potato gnocchi
  • 1½ cups cherry tomatoes halved
  • 2 Tbsp olive oil

For the sausage:

  • 12 oz smoked sausage sliced into coins
  • 1 red bell pepper cut into strips

To finish

  • salt and pepper to taste
  • ¼ cup fresh basil (torn)

Instructions

Roast

  • Heat the oven to 425°F.

Notes

  • Any smoked sausage works.

  1. 2 cups of tomatoes was even better
